function.arguments: {"observation": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate values, meaning that 48 patients appear more than once in the dataset. According to the data dictionary, a patient may be re-tested, and the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.", "implication": "To compute the mean baseline biomarker value per patient, we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient. Otherwise, we would double-count re-tested patients and bias the mean. This changes the population from 'all rows with severity == 'severe'' to 'all deduplicated patients with severity == 'severe' and biomarker_baseline != -999'."}
function.name: note_finding
